subject: POC trial planning - HorizonCare (RACI & next steps)
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Ramirez <elena.ramirez@horizoncare.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-03-18T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: POC trial planning - HorizonCare

Thanks again for the call this morning, Elena — really helpful to understand the evaluation priorities. Below is a short recap + proposed plan so we can align on success criteria and owners before we kick off the trial.

Recap / success criteria (proposed)
- Functional: model provides clinically relevant suggestions for intake summaries with >= 85% accuracy on a 200-case blind eval set (you can tweak this).
- Latency: 95th percentile tail <= 200ms for single-request flow from HorizonCare app to Redwood endpoint (staging).
- Throughput: sustain 10 requests/sec during peak simulation.
- Data & security: no PHI leaves HorizonCare network; KMS-managed keys; audit logs retained 90 days.

Evaluation plan
- Week 0: network + infra prep (VPC peering / firewall rules)
- Weeks 1-2: ingest sample dataset, run functional evaluations & edge-case tests
- Week 3: load test + tuning, final review & go/no-go decision

Timeline (proposed)
- Kickoff: week of Apr 5 (suggested Apr 5 or Apr 6)
- 3-week POC (approx Apr 5/6 — Apr 24)

RACI / ownership (initial)
- Infra (VPC/network, firewall, routing): HorizonCare IT - Michael Thornton (owner)
- App integration (API calls, client-side changes): HorizonCare app team - Elena Ramirez (owner)
- Security & compliance (questionnaire, KMS, audit logs): Redwood - Soojin Lee (Redwood lead), HorizonCare InfoSec - Michael Thornton (review)
- POC engineering & runtime setup: Redwood SE - Aditya Rao (owner)
- Success metrics & business sign-off: HorizonCare product sponsor - TBD; Redwood CS - Lauren Bishop (owner on Redwood side)
- Procurement / contracting: HorizonCare procurement (procurement@horizoncare.com) and Redwood legal/dev operations - Dev Patel (cc'd internally)

Attachments: I'll share a draft RACI matrix and a short SOW for kickoff.

Ask / next steps
1) Please confirm owners above (who should be the primary POC contacts for each area).
2) Confirm preferred kickoff date (Apr 5 vs Apr 6) — procurement timeline may push us a day, so we can be flexible.
3) Any additional success criteria we should add (e.g., specific regulatory checks, residency constraints)?

Thanks — happy to adjust. I can send a calendar invite once we lock the date.

--
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.ai

Hi all — looping in early with a security checklist so HorizonCare knows what we'll need for a Private VPC trial. High-level items: \

Security checklist (initial)
- Data flow diagram + sample dataset (we only need redacted samples; no PHI in transit for initial tests).
- SOC 2 attestation (we will share our report).
- KMS integration: ideally customer-managed keys (we can support bring-your-own-key via AWS KMS/HSM).
- Audit logs: API & admin logs retained 90 days; we can extend if needed.
- Network: VPC peering, limited IP allowlist, and TLS mutual auth for the tunnel.
\Owners (suggested)
- Redwood security lead: Soojin Lee (config + questionnaire)
- HorizonCare security reviewer: Michael Thornton (primary) + your security architect (please share contact)
\Deliverables I'll provide this week: \
- Completed HorizonCare security questionnaire (attached as HorizonCare_Security_Questionnaire.pdf)
- Short KMS integration notes + sample Terraform snippets (drive link)
\Note on PHI: For the POC we recommend redacted data where possible. If you need to run with real PHI, we'll require a narrow-scoped access review and an updated DPA. Let's flag that now so procurement/legal can plan.
\--
Soojin Lee
Head of Security & Compliance | Redwood Inference
